task_description: Find the worst site this month on the dashboard you normally use, and say on which figure
success_criterion: site and figure named match the fixture data (worst = lowest value on that figure for the period)

task_description: Explain why one figure changed versus last period (what moved, by how much, from which data)
success_criterion: the change and its size match the fixture data; any cause given is backed by a note/ticket shown on screen, not guessed

task_description: From a figure that is off target, find the action (or the page where it is handled) that addresses it
success_criterion: the action / page reached is the one linked to that figure in the fixture data

task_description: Compare two sites named by the facilitator on one figure and say which is better and by how much
success_criterion: the better site and the gap match the fixture data (same period, same unit)
